name: EPIC 249658444
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 7.0 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,521 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.88 solar masses and 7.0 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,808 K at its surface.
